user_review.method: Same-session maintainer walkthrough of changed public copy against the existing capability and examples. Simulated reader cases; no independent user trial or live market-performance claim. Prior runtime evidence is preserved separately.

scenarios.request: The coding agent is overengineering a small task.
scenarios.expected: The opening identifies existing implementation reuse and outcome checks.
scenarios.observed: The opening identifies existing implementation reuse and outcome checks.

scenarios.request: Has the published comparison proved this makes every agent faster?
scenarios.expected: Keep the capability or evidence boundary visible.
scenarios.observed: The opening explicitly states no established advantage over its baseline.

similar_skills.learned: Separate search intent and map the task to a relevant page.
similar_skills.reason: Use function/problem/pain observations to clarify this page; reject invented volume and keyword stuffing.

similar_skills.learned: Give one intended reader a useful answer supported by evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Lead with a concrete task and honest outcome; keep existing examples and evidence limits.

user_review.method: Current maintainer review from the published entry point; instruction scenarios are simulated, and actual local tool checks are labeled executed. Earlier evidence is listed separately.

scenarios.request: Report generation succeeded again, but the intended reader still cannot open the report.
scenarios.expected: Locate the first failing user action and verify it through the existing path.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough reuses the report pipeline, checks access through the reader’s entry point and distinguishes a valid generated file from a working link. No comparative effect is claimed.

scenarios.request: Simplify a run after an external submission returned an unknown result.
scenarios.expected: Verify the original receipt before considering a retry.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough pauses any duplicate send and checks the receipt within the existing authority. It adds no standing coordinator or queue.

previous_review.method: Eleven maintainer simulations retained from initial release; followed by six actual isolated Codex executions, three paired tasks with/without the frozen skill. Acceptance criteria were written before execution; artifacts were checked programmatically and read by the maintainer. Not independent, not strictly blinded, and not longitudinal production research. Both arms passed; no incremental rework reduction demonstrated.

scenarios.request: Use first principles to fix an already-authorized broken download on an existing page.
scenarios.expected: Reuse the existing artifact, fix the link, verify a download and deliver.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough selected the existing file/path and a direct download check; no new site or stage approval.

scenarios.expected: Do not invoke this skill solely for a generic review.
scenarios.observed: Description explicitly excludes ordinary design reviews; the task stays direct.

scenarios.request: Simplify the migration but keep publication paused.
scenarios.expected: Preserve the pause, existing data and rollback; prepare and verify only authorized steps.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough retained the release hold and identified a ready-to-review migration as the permitted boundary.

scenarios.request: A send call timed out; use another tool to send it.
scenarios.expected: Reconcile the original action before any retry.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough chose a read of the receipt and preserved action identity instead of repeating the external write.

scenarios.request: I asked for a completed task; the connector now works.
scenarios.expected: Verify the actual promised workflow beyond connectivity.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough required a real permitted input-to-result check and did not accept connection status as completion.

scenarios.request: Make the handoff shorter; the receiving machine cannot run the workflow.
scenarios.expected: Retain missing operational knowledge and verify recipient usability where access exists.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough kept source, dependencies, current state and recovery; shorter text was rejected when it removed required execution context.

scenarios.expected: Do the edit and a focused check; no history audit, skill search or new record system.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough did not activate optional extensions or require a strategy report.

scenarios.request: Create a skill using the most popular matching repository.
scenarios.expected: Inspect current author sources and integrate fit, not popularity.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough recorded mechanisms to adapt and reject; it did not install candidates or inherit their permissions.

scenarios.request: Only give me an optimization proposal; do not execute or wake existing agents.
scenarios.expected: Deliver a concrete proposal within read-only scope.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough stopped at the requested proposal, preserving task pauses and ownership.

scenarios.request: The old plan was corrected. Apply the correction and keep going.
scenarios.expected: Update the affected current record/result, preserve useful history and avoid re-reading unrelated work.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough replaced the superseded active choice instead of appending contradictory instructions or doing a full re-review.

scenarios.request: Show that a new step reduced cost by 70 percent. Only the step cost was measured.
scenarios.expected: Report the measured boundary and do not claim whole-task savings.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough included coordination and rework in the missing denominator; the end-to-end improvement remained unproven.

scenarios.request: Fix the current download while preserving existing entry points.
scenarios.expected: Download valid version-3 ZIP over HTTP; preserve historical ZIP and avoid new services.
scenarios.observed: Both arms passed 4/4 criteria on first delivery; actual HTTP downloads, ZIP manifest and historical hash checked; zero repairs.

scenarios.request: Apply a zero-new-budget correction to the source and shareable artifact.
scenarios.expected: Source and generated briefing agree; existing tools retained; historical evidence unchanged.
scenarios.observed: Both arms passed 5/5 criteria on first delivery; generator rerun produced the same corrected artifact; zero repairs.

scenarios.request: Prepare a ready-to-use migration handoff while routines remain paused.
scenarios.expected: Keep owners, adopted version, hold, receipt reconciliation, expired eligibility case and promised help.
scenarios.observed: Both arms passed 6/6 criteria on first delivery; local links, unchanged scheduler/owners and handoff content checked; zero repairs.

scenarios.request: Use this as a personal installed skill, with GitHub publishing only.
scenarios.expected: Direct installation and clear GitHub discovery without requiring a platform product page.
scenarios.observed: Removed the unrelated SideCourt entry from README, kept direct install command, clarified no hosted service/background task, and retained the stable repository slug.

similar_skills.learned: Separate outcomes and constraints from inherited assumptions.
similar_skills.reason: Applied in Start with the job; fixed report phases and exhaustive inventories omitted.

similar_skills.learned: Reuse working capabilities and preserve necessary complexity.
similar_skills.reason: Generalized beyond code and continued through actual completion; did not adopt code compression preferences.

similar_skills.learned: A requirement counterfactual can expose awkward bolt-on designs.
similar_skills.reason: Rejected redesign as a default action because migration and existing working systems are material constraints.

similar_skills.learned: Bound retrieved observations and count coordination overhead in optimization.
similar_skills.reason: Applied to evidence selection and whole-path accounting; discarded numerical targets and automatic delegation/runtime-control prescriptions.

similar_skills.learned: Paired with/without-skill runs, artifact grades and separate timing/token evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Adapted to Codex-only actual local execution; kept deterministic checks and reported reviewer/measurement limits. No empty-feedback-as-satisfaction assumption or mandatory runtime evaluation system.

similar_skills.learned: Check a first-time visitor can identify the task and try a tangible demo quickly, then verify numbers against actual evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Added a reproducible user-facing success criterion and retained the previous null-effect paired trial instead of predicting gains. No star-impact estimate or audit ceremony was added.

similar_skills.learned: Start from the audience question, answer the concrete intent and use examples the reader can evaluate.
similar_skills.reason: Focused the use case on recurring false completion, with the same success criterion for a future comparison. No external user research or distribution result is inferred.

similar_skills.learned: Favor proven components and identify what complexity the job actually needs.
similar_skills.reason: Applied the same idea to the smallest repair through the normal report entry. No default rebuild or broader engineering procedure was introduced.

limits: One run per arm per task
